sections.heading: Data Collection
sections.body: Leaflet stores your plants, care schedules, care history, growth measurements, notes, and photos locally on your device. We do not collect, transmit, or store any of that on our servers. There is no account, login, or cloud sync.

sections.heading: What Data Is Stored
sections.body: Your plants, care schedules, care history, growth measurements, and notes are stored in a local SQLite database on your device. This data never leaves your phone unless you choose to export a backup file yourself.

sections.heading: Photos & Camera
sections.body: If you add a photo to a plant or a journal entry, the app accesses your camera or photo library only at the moment you choose an image. Photos you select are copied into the app's local storage on your device and are never uploaded anywhere.

sections.heading: Notifications
sections.body: Care reminders are scheduled locally on your device. No notification data is sent to any server, and you can decline or revoke the notification permission at any time in your system settings.

sections.heading: Backups
sections.body: Leaflet lets you export your plant journal to a backup file and restore it later. These backup files are created and stored only where you choose to save them. We never receive, access, or transmit them.

sections.heading: Crash reporting
sections.body: Leaflet uses Firebase Crashlytics to collect anonymous crash diagnostics (device model, OS version, and the technical state of the app at the moment of a crash). No personal information, plant data, notes, or photos are ever transmitted. Crash reports exist solely so we can fix defects.

sections.heading: Usage analytics
sections.body:
Leaflet uses Google Analytics for Firebase to understand which features are used, so we can improve the app. It records anonymous, pseudonymous signals only — which screens you open, how often core features are used, the app version, your device model, and your coarse region (country level). It never records anything you type or photograph: not a plant, a care note, or a photo.
In regions where consent is required (EEA, UK, Switzerland), your analytics consent is handled through the same consent form shown for advertising, which you can change at any time from Settings → Manage Ad Consent. Crash reporting, above, is separate and covered under our legitimate interest in keeping the app working.

sections.heading: Ads
sections.body: The free version shows a single banner advertisement served by Google AdMob. In regions where consent is required (EEA, UK, Switzerland), you will be asked for your consent choices before ads are requested, and you can change them at any time from Settings → Manage Ad Consent. Upgrade to Premium to remove all ads.

sections.heading: In-App Purchases
sections.body: The one-time Premium purchase is processed through Google Play (Android) or the Apple App Store (iOS). We do not handle or store any payment data directly.

sections.heading: Your Rights
sections.body: All your data is yours. You can export it anytime from within the app, or delete it entirely by uninstalling the app. We have no central record of your data.

sections.heading: Contact
